description: This file defines the AccountReadPlatformService interface in the Fineract project, specifying methods related to account data retrieval.

classes.name: AccountReadPlatformService
classes.description: Interface defining account retrieval operations within the Fineract platform.

methods.name: retrieveTemplate
methods.description: Retrieves a template for account data based on client and product IDs.

methods.name: retrieveOne
methods.description: Retrieves a specific account data by its ID, optionally including template information.

methods.name: retrieveAll
methods.description: Returns a paginated list of all account data, with offset and limit controls.

methods.name: getResponseDataParams
methods.description: Returns the set of response data parameters available.
